structuredChecks.hierarchy: Promise/action precede setting. Original capture or explicitly labelled artwork has its own plane. Lifecycle status stays by CTA; lengthy compact heroes postpone screen evidence.
structuredChecks.typography: System sans hierarchy is legible at real content lengths and 200% scene font. Calorie and Context have long headline/paragraph stacks. Native rounded/monospaced operation controls need not become marketing display type.
structuredChecks.composition: Art has a usable calm live-copy region. Compact copy then complete image preserves scale. Screenshot planes are distinct. Kith scene carries its photo world; other scenes repeat a shared side-table grammar more than bespoke full-page composition.
structuredChecks.identity: Setline and Storage strongest subject-specific signatures. Motion relies on logo/copy for body input. Context blank files are comparatively generic. Daddy family similarities are owner-directed; source/current-native alignment remains bounded.
structuredChecks.interaction: Independent 320px reduced-motion sessions: scene anchors resolve and FAQ disclosures open in all ten; visible skip-link focus. Kith skip moves reading start to main and next Tab enters hero action. Full-size original images are linked for screenshot/historical heroes. Actual native CTA handoff remains unobserved.
structuredChecks.responsive: Observed 320/390/768/1440 hierarchy retained; 200% desktop scene text remains readable without horizontal overflow. No observed scene text/object collision in current independent captures. 768 root screenshots are rendered evidence, not root findings.
